headline: ForTy releases a global 10 m forest typology map and early annual change series
summary: Google DeepMind, Google Research, the World Resources Institute and IIASA released ForTy, a global 10 m map classifying 2020 land into six forest and land-use types, alongside an early annual series for 2017–2025. The authors describe a cascaded deep-learning pipeline trained using about 1.7 million labeled locations and AlphaEarth satellite embeddings. In the paper’s validation, 8,190 of 9,100 sampled sites were resolved by expert consensus; the authors report 90.2% stratified overall accuracy for six classes. Performance varies by class: planted forest had the lowest reported F1 at 58.2%, while the dominant Other category strongly influences aggregate accuracy. The data are publicly available, but the time series is preliminary and this review did not independently validate the maps.
